name: Temburong
intro: Brunei’s eastern enclave is its rainforest heartland: protected lowland forest, river journeys, canopy views, community-based eco-tourism and forest trails.

places.name: Ulu Temburong National Park
places.why: Protected rainforest landscape reached on guided river and land transfers, with canopy and forest experiences

places.name: Canopy Walkway, Ulu Temburong
places.why: Elevated canopy experience offering views across the rainforest; visited as part of an authorised park excursion

places.name: Sumbiling Eco Village
places.why: Community-based eco-tourism base for river, rainforest and cultural activities

places.name: Batang Duri
places.why: Riverside gateway village for journeys into the Temburong rainforest

places.name: Bukit Patoi Forest Recreation Park
places.why: Forest reserve with a hiking route to a hilltop viewpoint over the surrounding landscape

places.name: Peradayan Forest Recreation Park
places.why: Forest recreation area with trails and viewpoints in the Temburong interior

places.name: Bangar Town
places.why: Small district town and practical base for exploring Temburong

places.name: Peliunan Park
places.why: Local recreation stop in Temburong; confirm access and facilities before travelling

places.name: Sultan Haji Omar 'Ali Saifuddien Bridge
places.why: Major bridge linking the Brunei-Muara mainland with the Temburong district across Brunei Bay

places.name: Belalong River
places.why: Rainforest river corridor used for guided boat journeys and nature experiences

places.name: Kuala Belalong Field Studies Centre
places.why: Rainforest research facility associated with long-running tropical ecology studies; access is controlled and requires prior arrangements
